_comment: Hand-edited facet overrides for catalog/build.py. Keys starting with '_' are ignored.
lineage_regex: optional; replaces build.py's DEFAULT_LINEAGE_REGEX wholesale (object order = priority).
ignore_values: optional; replaces DEFAULT_IGNORE_VALUES (tool-default INFO strings skipped by the lineage regexes).
fonts: keyed by sha256 (rename-proof) or by exact file name; a filename entry is applied on top of a sha256 entry.
Allowed per-font keys: lineage, completeness, bank_map, instrument, year, decade, license_flag, publish, label, notes (+ file / _comment for humans).

Some Other Font.sf2.notes: filename-keyed entry; wins over a sha256 entry for the same file
